questions.question: Which of the following is not considered as self- generated feedback?

option_explanations.C: Retracing one's steps is a self-check, hence self-generated feedback.
option_explanations.D: Observation of one's own performance gives self-generated feedback.

questions.question: If PACE is coded as 2561925, then BALL will be coded as:

question_data.stem: If PACE is coded as 2561925, then BALL will be coded as:

questions.explanation: Landes identifies mechanization, new power sources and extensive use of new raw materials as the streams. Modifying equipment to make life easy is not one of them.

questions.question: Two persons A and B finish a work in 10 days. A is twice as efficient than B. How many days A will take to finish the work, if he has to do it alone?

question_data.stem: Two persons A and B finish a work in 10 days. A is twice as efficient than B. How many days A will take to finish the work, if he has to do it alone?

questions.explanation: A is twice as efficient as B, so rates are 2 and 1 units per day. Total work = 3 × 10 = 30 units. A alone takes 30 / 2 = 15 days.

option_explanations.C: Correct. 30 units at 2 per day = 15 days.

questions.question: A boat takes an hour to cover a certain distance downstream in a river. It takes 1 1/2 hour to cover the same distance upstream. Assuming that the speed of boat is same in both downstream and upstream directions, what is the ratio of speed of boat to that of stream in the river?

question_data.stem: A boat takes an hour to cover a certain distance downstream in a river. It takes 1 1/2 hour to cover the same distance upstream. Assuming that the speed of boat is same in both downstream and upstream directions, what is the ratio of speed of boat to that of stream in the river?

questions.explanation: Let distance be d. Downstream speed = d, upstream speed = d/1.5 = 2d/3. Boat = (d + 2d/3)/2 = 5d/6, stream = (d − 2d/3)/2 = d/6. Ratio = 5 : 1.
